# Vendor icons

View 04 uses the source icons below to identify the platform components.

| Asset | Pinned source | Notice |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [GitHub mark](github.svg) | [GitHub Primer Octicons](https://github.com/primer/octicons/blob/68ec2de8d0ddfcbb7497da01d0b7d98eb5593020/icons/mark-github-24.svg) | [MIT license](PRIMER-LICENSE) and [GitHub Brand Toolkit](https://brand.github.com/foundations/logo) |
| [Flux](flux.svg) | [CNCF Artwork](https://github.com/cncf/artwork/blob/6b5a2ec58e8ef26ddeeaa409425ba1bfd9005f8e/projects/flux/icon/color/flux-icon-color.svg) | [CNCF notice](CNCF-NOTICE.md) |
| [Kubernetes](kubernetes.svg) | [CNCF Artwork](https://github.com/cncf/artwork/blob/6b5a2ec58e8ef26ddeeaa409425ba1bfd9005f8e/projects/kubernetes/icon/color/kubernetes-icon-color.svg) | [CNCF notice](CNCF-NOTICE.md) |

The generator preserves the original paths, proportions and colors. It scopes CSS class names in the exported SVG so their styles remain independent.
